name: Manuel Grossmann
headline: Founding Partner Amino Collective | Backing Health & Bio Founders
summary:
I back obsessive scientists and entrepreneurs building generational businesses in health and bio - the ones future generations still remember. I founded Amino Collective after years on both sides: As operator at Kry/Livi (one of Europe's leading digital health companies) and on the investment team at Earlybird.

Amino is a collective of founders, operators, and world-class LPs united by one belief: breakthrough innovation comes from those radically open to learning, not those who assume they have all the answers.

We invest at seed, lead or follow, and are geo-agnostic. To date, I’ve backed 30+ companies across health and bio, including Allcyte (acq. Exscientia | Recursion), Anima, Aware, Awell, Biomia, Cosyne, Cradle, Enveda, ExpressionEdits, Hedera, Huminly, Inductive, Kano, Kernal, Lindus, Molecule, Portal, Rivia, Sensible, Seqera, Serna, Tandem, Vira, and Vital.  

See the full portfolio: aminocollective.com/investments

Building in health or bio? manuel@aminocollective.com
